hypothesis.statement: This is the FOURTH recorded instance of the eager-pre-prologue address-resolution class and the second inside game/mb/mb_model, and the four now have enough shape in common to be censused instead of probed one at a time. In every instance the target hoists ONLY the ADDR16_HA half above the prologue and completes the ADDR16_LO half into a callee-saved register after `stmw`, while ours completes both halves early and pays a copy. Here that reads, verbatim from the aligned view, as target `@0x04 lis r5,0  @lbl_80115DA8(ADDR16_HA)` then `@0x18 addi r31,r5,0  @lbl_80115DA8(ADDR16_LO)` against ours `@0x04 lis r5,0  @lbl_80115DA8(ADDR16_HA)`, `@0x0c addi r0,r5,0  @lbl_80115DA8(ADDR16_LO)` and `@0x24 mr r31,r0`. The next lane should count the population image-wide -- functions whose first differing cluster is an `addi rD,rA,0` with an ADDR16_LO relocation emitted between `stw r0,4(r1)` and `stwu` -- before spending another per-function probe, exactly as the ADDR16_LO home-copy census settled its class.
